limits: Native scenario durations are complete test durations, not startup measurements. Two user-owned virtual machines were still active; no cold-start speed result is claimed.
The x64 catalog, source dialog and long reader lifecycle suites preceded the isolated mounted-volume and page-appearance additions; exact native executable hashes are retained per run.
The full old Office conversion fixture matrix was not counted: feedback21 lacked an existing portable Office sample.

The earlier 90-second outer reader-spread watchdog timed out under concurrent packaging and VM load; the outer budget was aligned with the 180-second reader suite, without relaxing page-load assertions. Repeated final-format tests passed.
Only synthetic owned collections were mutated. Physical book files and the real desktop collection were not consolidated or deleted.
The page-appearance effect is static shading; no animated page curl is claimed.
Older installed versions rejecting a real mounted volume require one manual archive update to receive the new guard.
